Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.mandela.lang

Record Class Token

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.jdesktop.lg3d.mandela.lang.Token
Record Components:
kind - the lexical class
text - the lexeme (identifiers, operators) or the decoded body (strings)
line - the 1-based start line
column - the 1-based start column
endColumn - the 1-based column just past the token
longValue - the value of an TokenKind.INT literal
doubleValue - the value of a TokenKind.DOUBLE literal
parts - the pieces of an TokenKind.INTERP literal, otherwise empty
public record Token(TokenKind kind, String text, int line, int column, int endColumn, long longValue, double doubleValue, List<Token.InterpPiece> parts) extends Record
One immutable lexical token, with the position needed to report a problem back to a human.

Positions are 1-based line and column pairs, the convention every JVM compiler (javac, kotlinc) and the desktop's Espresso editor use for gutter markers, so a Mandela LangException maps onto an editor diagnostic without arithmetic.

Token payloads are typed by kind: text() carries an identifier, keyword or string body; longValue() and doubleValue() carry numeric literals; parts() carries the pieces of an interpolated string. Unused fields stay at their default, which keeps the record compact and the accessors honest (see the isX() helpers).

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with '=='.
